skill.summary: Detect common OO design smells in a codebase and recommend corrective design patterns. Use when reviewing code for design quality, investigating why changes...

latestVersion.changelog:
OO Design Smell Detector v1.0.0 – initial release

- Detects 8 categories of OO design smells, including object creation rigidity, operation dependencies, tight coupling, subclass explosion, and more.
- Maps each smell to relevant GoF design patterns and provides actionable refactoring recommendations.
- Supports scans via both source code analysis and textual design descriptions.
- Guides users on required context (scan target, language) and provides fallback options when details are missing.
- Includes a structured, step-by-step process with progress tracked via todos to ensure systematic coverage.
